cohort: The study included 48 consecutive women with atypical complex hyperplasia or endometrial cancer who underwent fertility-sparing treatment using LNG-IUS.
finding: Fertility-sparing treatment with LNG-IUS for patients with atypical complex hyperplasia or endometrial cancer achieves high regression rates (89.3% for ACH, 81.3% for G1 EC, 75.0% for G2 EC) and good fertility outcomes (73.7% of patients wishing to conceive achieved pregnancy).
